collection.title: Lexus RX Series RX 450H 2016 to 2022 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Lexus RX 450H 2016 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
